blocks.text: Timesheets for this week are due by close of business today, since the office is closed on Monday for the holiday. I checked the system before submitting my own, and yours are the two still open for the advisory group. Kimberly, your Thursday hours are saved but not yet submitted. Michael, yours just needs Wednesday filled in. Once both are in, the week can be closed out.
If it is easier, reply with your hours and I will enter them for you before I leave today.
